ex.en: Only a small minority of students voted against the proposal.
ex.zh: 只有少数学生对该提案投了反对票。

words.note: minority 与 majority 相对，指少数或少数民族。

ex.en: The earth rotates around its axis once every twenty-four hours.
ex.zh: 地球每二十四小时绕地轴自转一周。

words.note: axis 复数为 axes，横轴是 horizontal axis。

ex.en: The expedition reached the South Pole after months of hardship.
ex.zh: 探险队历经数月艰辛抵达南极。

words.note: pole 指地理极或杆；poles apart 表大相径庭。

ex.en: For short journeys, cycling is often preferable to driving.
ex.zh: 短途出行时，骑车往往比开车更好。

words.note: preferable 本身含「更」，后接 to 而不接 than。

ex.en: He made no reference to the accident in his report.
ex.zh: 他在报告中没有提到那起事故。

words.note: make reference to 表提到；参考文献用 reference list。

ex.en: In spite of the heavy rain, the match went on as planned.
ex.zh: 尽管大雨，比赛仍按计划进行。

words.note: in spite of 后接名词或动名词，不能接句子。

ex.en: The defendant told the court that he had never met the victim.
ex.zh: 被告向法庭陈述自己从未见过受害者。

words.note: defendant 指被告，plaintiff 是原告，注意区分。

ex.en: She arranged for a taxi to pick us up at the airport.
ex.zh: 她安排了一辆出租车到机场接我们。

words.note: arrange 常用 arrange for sb to do sth 结构。

ex.en: Cook the vegetables gently in olive oil for about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 用橄榄油把蔬菜小火煮约十分钟。

words.note: olive branch 常比喻伸出橄榄枝、表示和解。

ex.en: The bag was made of coarse cloth that scratched my skin.
ex.zh: 这个包用粗布做成，磨得我皮肤发疼。

words.note: coarse 与 course 同音，指质地粗糙或言谈粗俗。

ex.en: The media often exaggerate the risks of travelling alone.
ex.zh: 媒体常夸大独自旅行的风险。

words.note: exaggerate 指夸大事实；名词 exaggeration 在口语中很常用。

ex.en: The new manager streamlined the approval process to save time.
ex.zh: 新经理简化了审批流程以节省时间。

words.note: streamline 原指使成流线型，引申为精简流程。

ex.en: His silence seemed to imply that he did not agree with the plan.
ex.zh: 他的沉默似乎暗示他不同意这个计划。

words.note: imply 是说话人暗示，infer 是听者推断，方向相反。

ex.en: Higher fuel prices were offset by lower taxes on vehicles.
ex.zh: 油价上涨被车辆税收降低所抵消。

words.note: offset 常用 be offset by 结构，过去式与原形同形。

ex.en: The company has made a firm commitment to reduce its emissions.
ex.zh: 公司已郑重承诺减少排放。

words.note: commitment 后接 to 加名词或动名词；动词是 commit。

ex.en: The dentist found a small cavity in one of my back teeth.
ex.zh: 牙医在我一颗后牙上发现了一个小龋洞。

words.note: cavity 指体内或物体内的空腔，与 cave 同源。

ex.en: He called himself a coward for running away from the fight.
ex.zh: 他因临阵脱逃而骂自己是胆小鬼。

words.note: coward 指人，形容词 cowardly，抽象名词 cowardice。

ex.en: The museum's collection includes fossils of plants and small animals.
ex.zh: 该博物馆的藏品包括植物和小动物的化石。

words.note: fossil fuel 指煤、石油、天然气；fossil 也比喻老顽固。

ex.en: Don't poke the fire with a plastic stick; use the metal poker.
ex.zh: 别用塑料棒捅火，要用金属火钳。

words.note: poke fun at 意为拿…开玩笑，是常见短语。

ex.en: After several rejections, her novel was finally accepted by a small publisher.
ex.zh: 被拒多次后，她的小说终于被一家小出版社接受。

words.note: rejection 指被拒的结果，可数；动词是 reject。

ex.en: The old clock has become a familiar fixture in the school hall.
ex.zh: 这座旧钟已成为学校礼堂里熟悉的一景。

words.note: fixture 指固定安装的设备；体育里指已定的比赛。

ex.en: The factory manufactures components for several electric car companies.
ex.zh: 这家工厂为几家电动汽车公司制造零部件。

words.note: manufacture 多指机器大批量制造，比 make 正式。

ex.en: The accident was caused by a collision between a bus and a van.
ex.zh: 这起事故由一辆公交车与一辆货车相撞引起。

words.note: collision 后接 with 或 between；动词是 collide。

ex.en: The photographs are arranged in the correct sequence on the wall.
ex.zh: 墙上的照片按正确顺序排列。

words.note: sequence 指先后次序；in sequence 表依次，不加 the。

ex.en: The firm plans to recruit fifty engineers next year.
ex.zh: 这家公司计划明年招聘五十名工程师。

words.note: recruit 用于招聘或招兵；名词 recruit 指新兵、新成员。

ex.en: The contract contains a provision that allows either side to withdraw.
ex.zh: 合同含有一项条款，允许任一方退出。

words.note: provision 表准备时不可数，表条款时可数。

ex.en: Running for half an hour burns about three hundred calories.
ex.zh: 跑步半小时约消耗三百卡热量。

words.note: 口语中的 calorie 多指千卡，即大卡。

ex.en: The slogan on the poster was simple and easy to remember.
ex.zh: 海报上的口号简短易记。

words.note: slogan 指宣传口号；motto 指个人或团体的座右铭。

ex.en: He is invariably the first to arrive and the last to leave.
ex.zh: 他总是第一个到，最后一个走。

words.note: invariably 相当于 always，语气更书面。

ex.en: The ceremony will commence at nine o'clock sharp.
ex.zh: 典礼将于九点整开始。

words.note: commence 比 begin 正式，多用于典礼、工程、诉讼。
